entities.summary: Emre Batur is a Turkish professional volleyball player. He played for Fenerbahçe Grundig since 2005 before he transferred to Halkbank Ankara in the 2012-13 season. He played 25 times for national team. He also played for Tokat Plevne Belediyesi.
